applies_why: The judge text does not count any verse on a cited-in line as an unanswered witness; it declares a challenge underdetermined because the challenged curse limb was dropped.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count.
why: Because the judge text does not treat a verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link, K-G4 does not govern it.
